profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. It is a non-profit government lab founded in 2020. Its website presents the Falcon LLM family as generative large language models intended to make advanced AI accessible and to support applications across industries. The institute has also launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and AI71, an AI company launched by the Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne.

The Falcon line includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, Falcon Arabic, Falcon H1R 7B, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon 40B, and Falcon 10B. The site describes Falcon 2 11B as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities, and states that it outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. It also states that Falcon-H1 uses a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture and outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen. Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, while Falcon 40B has 40 billion parameters and was trained on one trillion tokens. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open source released State Space Language Model. The tracked product, Falcon (TII), is described as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0, with Middle East data residency and a sovereign AI focus.

No litigation or regulatory filings are noted for the institute.
